era.title: Post-Scarcity Foundations
era.subtitle: The systems that make abundance practical, universal, and stable
era.description: This era establishes the foundations of post-scarcity civilization through universal services, fusion energy, advanced medicine, clean water, low-cost housing, circular materials, and AI-managed public infrastructure.

seo.metaTitle: Era 3: Post-Scarcity Foundations | Future Civilization Roadmap
seo.metaDescription: Explore post-scarcity foundations including universal basic services, fusion energy, clean water, AI food logistics, robotic eldercare, open-source medicine, and low-cost housing.

items.title: Universal basic services replace traditional welfare
items.description: Food, housing support, healthcare, education, transport, connectivity, and essential utilities increasingly become guaranteed public infrastructure rather than fragmented welfare programs.
items.civilizationImpact: Basic survival becomes less dependent on income, reducing insecurity and allowing more people to pursue education, care, creativity, and civic participation.
signals: Governments shift from cash-only welfare toward service guarantees
AI systems coordinate eligibility, delivery, and fraud prevention
Public infrastructure budgets prioritize food, health, housing, and connectivity access
implications: Lower extreme poverty and household instability
New debates around rights, access, and public digital identity
A broader definition of citizenship and social safety
